title: Studio Membership with Raku Access
source_quote: Participation in our monthly, member only Raku firings (firing fees additional)
evidence_sentence: The membership page lists participation in monthly member-only raku firings as a benefit of studio membership.
evidence_quote: Participation in our monthly, member only Raku firings (firing fees additional)
summary: Studio membership (resident or non-resident) provides access to monthly raku firings, firing at discounted rates on electric kilns, and free member workshops. Monthly, quarterly, or annual membership available.
how_to_join: Download membership registration form from website; minimum 6-month commitment for resident; trial month available ($190)
commitment: Minimum 6 months (two quarters) for resident membership
